description: This Java interface `ModifyAttributesLiveCommand` defines a live command for modifying attributes within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It provides methods to access the attributes to be modified and extends multiple interfaces to support command execution and answer building in a live context.

classes.name: ModifyAttributesLiveCommand
classes.description: Java interface representing a live command to modify attributes in the Eclipse Ditto system, including methods to retrieve the attributes to modify and supporting the command and answer builder interfaces.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Returns the Attributes object containing the attributes to be modified.
